_comment: Disclosure lines shown with the contact buttons once a workshop is attached. Approved wording. 'independence' and 'selectionMethod' show in trial mode; 'paidBy' shows in trial and tenant mode with different text; 'underButtonNote' shows under the buttons for trial and tenant (wording still to come). {{ brand }} comes from site.json and {{ workshop.name }} from that area's routing.json entry. The build refuses to show a TODO line on a live (trial/tenant) page.

independence.ms: {{ brand }} ialah panduan bebas dan tidak bergabung dengan bengkel ini.
independence.en: {{ brand }} is an independent guide and isn't affiliated with them.

selectionMethod.ms: Dipilih berdasarkan ulasan Google awam dan, jika diketahui, tempoh beroperasi.
selectionMethod.en: Chosen from public Google reviews and, where known, years in business.

trial.ms: Kami tidak dibayar oleh bengkel yang kami cadangkan.
trial.en: We aren't paid by the workshops we suggest.

tenant.ms: {{ workshop.name }} membayar yuran tetap kepada {{ brand }} untuk dipaparkan di sini. Ia tidak mengubah harga yang mereka sebut kepada anda.
tenant.en: {{ workshop.name }} pays {{ brand }} a flat fee to be featured here. It doesn't change the price they quote you.

underButtonNote.en: TODO – under-button note, wording to come
